title: Add adversarial mutations for proof and release gates
goal: Exercise existing gates against intentionally invalid candidate artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Mutants include false/missing roots, custom axioms, changed definitions, stale artifacts, weak hypotheses and skipped checking.
Each mutant fails the intended gate; checker-unavailable and failed-write cases are infrastructure rather than proof rejection.
Unproved extern/implemented_by substitution and forged coverage/package manifests cannot obtain a stronger claim.
human_review: Independent gate-audit review of detection assertions
scope_rule: Only explicitly sealed artifact/file scope; meaning, checker, workflow, release and reporting changes require dedicated independent human review.
